title: Luke Bible Quiz - Chapter 10
description: Ten questions on Luke 10: the seventy sent out two by two, the good Samaritan, and Martha and Mary.

questions.text: How many others did the Lord appoint and send ahead of him?
questions.explanation: The Lord appointed seventy others and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place where he was about to come.

answers.text: Twelve
Thirty
Seventy
A hundred

questions.text: What did he say about the harvest and the laborers?
questions.explanation: He said the harvest is plentiful but the laborers are few, and told them to pray to the Lord of the harvest to send out laborers.

answers.text: The harvest is plentiful, but the laborers are few
The harvest is small, but the laborers are many
Both the harvest and the laborers are few
The harvest must wait for another year

questions.text: What were they told to carry on the way?
questions.explanation: They were told to carry no purse, no wallet and no sandals, and to greet no one on the way.

answers.text: A purse and a wallet
Sandals and a staff
Bread for the journey
No purse, wallet or sandals

questions.text: What did the seventy report with joy when they returned?
questions.explanation: The seventy returned with joy and said that even the demons were subject to them in his name.

answers.text: That every city had received them gladly
That even the demons were subject to them in his name
That they had healed every sick person in the cities
That they had wiped the dust off their feet

questions.text: What did he tell them to rejoice in instead?
questions.explanation: He told them not to rejoice that the spirits are subject to them, but to rejoice that their names are written in heaven.

answers.text: That they had authority over serpents
That the harvest was plentiful
That their names are written in heaven
That they had been sent two by two

questions.text: How did the lawyer answer the question about what is written in the law?
questions.explanation: He answered that you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, strength and mind, and your neighbor as yourself.

answers.text: Do not steal and do not give false testimony
Tithe everything you get and fast twice a week
Honor your father and your mother
Love the Lord your God with everything, and your neighbor as yourself

questions.text: What did the priest and the Levite do when they saw the wounded man?
questions.explanation: Both the priest and the Levite saw the man and passed by on the other side.

answers.text: They passed by on the other side
They carried him to an inn
They called for a Samaritan to help
They bound up his wounds and left him

questions.text: What did the Samaritan pour on the wounded man's wounds?
questions.explanation: The Samaritan bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine.

answers.text: Water and myrrh
Oil and wine
Oil and water
Wine and salt

questions.text: How much money did the Samaritan give to the host of the inn?
questions.explanation: He took out two denarii and gave them to the host, and promised to repay whatever more was spent.

answers.text: Ten drachma coins
Fifty denarii
A hundred batos of oil
Two denarii

questions.text: What did Jesus say about Mary when Martha complained?
questions.explanation: Jesus said that Mary had chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.

answers.text: She had chosen the good part, which will not be taken away
She should get up and help her sister
She was anxious and troubled about many things
She had not yet heard his word
